summary: Controlled notification preferences page with an unsubscribe-from-all request.
whenToUse: Letting users change notification categories and channels or request to unsubscribe.
whenNotToUse: For cookie or data consent, use PrivacyPreferences or CookieBanner.

props.name: title
props.description: Page title and name of the matrix.

props.name: onUnsubscribeAll
props.description: Callback to the consumer; it does not send or persist anything.

keyboard.action: Navigates the preferences and the unsubscribe button.

accessibility: The preferences matrix is built with NotificationPreferences and the title describes the page.
responsive: The container and the matrix adapt to narrow widths.
customization: Reuses NotificationPreferences and Button with --dc-* tokens.
commonMistakes: The unsubscribe request is not sent automatically.
limits: Request handling and persistence are external.
